array.string:
launchctl setenv EDITOR 'zed --wait'
launchctl setenv XDG_CACHE_HOME $HOME/.cache launchctl setenv XDG_CONFIG_HOME $HOME/.config launchctl setenv XDG_DATA_HOME $HOME/.local/share launchctl setenv PATH "$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
launchctl setenv GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT 1 launchctl setenv GOPATH $XDG_DATA_HOME/go launchctl setenv PATH "$GOPATH/bin:$PATH" launchctl setenv GOPRIVATE github.com/devrev launchctl setenv COLIMA_HOME $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/colima
launchctl setenv ARCUS_API_KEY $(/usr/bin/security find-generic-password -a devrev -s arcus-token -w) launchctl setenv DEVREV_API_KEY $(/usr/bin/security find-generic-password -a devrev -s devrev-token -w)
